differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
differential.rationale: Obesity (BMI 30), documented sleep apnea, and metabolic syndrome increase likelihood.

differential.name: Metabolic syndrome (insulin‑resistant prediabetes)
differential.rationale: Presence of obesity, prediabetes (A1c 6.2 %), dyslipidemia and hypertension risk.

differential.name: Major depressive disorder (stress‑related)
differential.rationale: Chronic stress, unemployment, violence exposure, and chronic pain predispose to depressive illness.
